Q1: Which part of coding-workflows should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B. The orchestrator poller and project lifecycle (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C. The clarify, plan or implement phases (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`)
D. Documentation only (README, `docs/`, `agents.d/` fragments)
E. Something else: name the file, workflow or behaviour in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for this change?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure: give the run link, issue or PR where it showed up (RECOMMENDED)
B. Lower cost or runtime: name the phase or workflow, and the target
C. Add a new capability: describe the expected behaviour
D. Make the docs or operator experience clearer for a named audience
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A specific test, run or observable behaviour passes or changes: describe it (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable metric moves (cost, duration, failure rate): give the metric and the threshold
C. A reviewer decides on the PR (no objective criterion)
